rows.english: Start with a starter pack — nets, calling frequencies, POTA, and digital watering holes, ready to go. Or save the current frequency with ＋ Save, import a CHIRP CSV, or send repeaters here from the Repeaters section. Star a memory (★) and it shows on the MEM strip in every cockpit.

rows.previous: 从一个开始启动包- 网,呼叫频率,POTA数字水洞,准备出发 或者用+保存中,导入 CHIRP CSV,或从中继器区发送中继器。 恒星记忆(★),在每个驾驶舱的MEM条上显示.

rows.english: {{source}} lists no {{band}} repeaters here, which is unusual for an area that has any — its rural coverage is patchy, so this list is probably missing machines. Adding a RepeaterBook API token in Settings ▸ Integrations fills the gap.
rows.chinese: {{source}} 未列出此处的 {{band}} 中继台。对于已有中继台的地区，这并不常见；该数据源的乡村地区收录不完整，因此列表可能有遗漏。在设置 ▸ 集成服务中添加 RepeaterBook API 令牌可补充数据。
rows.previous: {{source}}列表无{{band}}这里的中继器,对于一个有某个区域来说是不寻常的——它的乡村覆盖是零星的,所以这个列表很可能是缺少的机器. 正在添加中继器Book API 令牌设置 QQ 整合补虚空.

rows.english: RepeaterBook did not answer for {{states}}, so repeaters there are missing from this list. That is a fetch that failed, not an empty area — fetch again in a few minutes.
rows.chinese: RepeaterBook 未返回 {{states}} 的数据，因此列表缺少这些州的中继台。这是获取失败，并不表示当地没有中继台。请过几分钟重新获取。
rows.previous: 中继器书没有回答{{states}},所以重复者在此列表中缺失。 这是一个失败的回收,而不是一个空地——几分钟后再次回收。

rows.english: The {{rsgb}} repeater list could not be read just now, so these are {{hearham}}'s machines alone. Fetch again later to add the coordinator's.
rows.chinese: 暂时无法读取 {{rsgb}} 中继台列表，因此当前仅显示 {{hearham}} 的中继台数据。请稍后重新获取，以补充频率协调机构的数据。
rows.previous: 那个{{rsgb}}复读器列表刚刚无法读取, 所以这些是{{hearham}}单靠机器。稍后再取来添加协调员的。

rows.english: The {{hearham}} repeater list could not be read just now, so its machines are missing from this list. Fetch again in a few minutes.
rows.chinese: 暂时无法读取 {{hearham}} 中继台列表，因此当前列表缺少该来源的中继台。请过几分钟重新获取。
rows.previous: 那个{{hearham}}重复列表无法在刚刚读取, 因此它的机器在此列表中丢失几分钟后再拿回来

rows.english: {{rsgb}} is asked about the locator squares nearest you, not every one this radius reaches, so the machines in {{squares}} are {{hearham}}'s alone.
rows.chinese: 仅向 {{rsgb}} 查询了离本台最近的网格，未覆盖整个搜索半径，因此 {{squares}} 中的中继台仅来自 {{hearham}}。
rows.previous: {{rsgb}}被问到离你最近的定位方块, 不是每个这个半径到达, 所以机器在{{squares}}已经{{hearham}}一个人

rows.english: {{rsgb}} is asked about the locator squares at the start of this route, not every one it crosses, so the machines in {{squares}} are {{hearham}}'s alone.
rows.chinese: 仅向 {{rsgb}} 查询了路线起点附近的网格，未查询沿途全部网格，因此 {{squares}} 中的中继台仅来自 {{hearham}}。
rows.previous: {{rsgb}}被问到这条路线开始时的定位方块, 不是每一个它穿过, 所以机器在{{squares}}已经{{hearham}}一个人

rows.english: {{rb}} is asked about the states at the start of this route, not every one it crosses, so the machines in {{states}} are {{hearham}}'s alone. Search the rest of the trip as a route of its own.
rows.chinese: 仅向 {{rb}} 查询了路线起点附近的州，未查询沿途全部州，因此 {{states}} 中的中继台仅来自 {{hearham}}。请将其余行程单独设为路线搜索。
rows.previous: {{rb}}被问到这条路线开始时的州, 不是每一个它穿过, 所以机器在{{states}}已经{{hearham}}一个人 搜余行为己行.

rows.english: Nexus could not read your saved channel lists, so it kept that file, untouched, at {{path}} and started a new list. Nothing was deleted.
rows.chinese: Nexus 无法读取已保存的信道列表，已将原文件完整保留在 {{path}}，并新建列表。未删除任何内容。
rows.previous: Nexus 无法读取您保存的频道列表, 因此它保留了该文件, 不加更改, at{{path}}并开始一个新的列表。 没有被删除。

rows.english: Nexus could not read your saved channel lists at {{path}} and could not move that file aside, so Repeaters will not save until it is moved or repaired. Nothing was deleted.
rows.chinese: Nexus 无法读取 {{path}} 中保存的信道列表，也无法将该文件移至备用位置。因此，在移走或修复文件前，中继台页面不会保存更改。未删除任何内容。
rows.previous: Nexus 无法读取您保存的频道列表{{path}}并且无法将文件移到一边, 因此中继器在移动或修复之前不会保存 。 没有被删除。
